text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How goes it? I'm Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got a real whopper of a dream. I
wanna do
the best I can in the Twinkle
Series... and b'come
a real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too familiar with all this urban
hustle 'n' bustle yet... but when it comes
to spunk, I've got ev'ryone beat! So
don't go easy on me when we're
trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
